phase_status.phase: SSM spec parity and export contract
evidence: Implementation plan claims feature-complete SSM parity with Phase 7 complete.
CSV builder still contains stale commentary saying "FromCache always False for now (no caching yet)" even though cache-aware logic exists in the same module.
One regression test around config defaults currently fails (expected export_strategy_diagnostics=False, actual True), suggesting test/spec drift.
gaps: Conflicting contract signals between docs/comments and runtime behavior in CSV export path.
Config default expectation mismatch indicates incomplete alignment between tests and intended baseline behavior.

evidence: Repository intentionally retains legacy and archive trees as historical code paths.
A test file with a space in filename (`tests/new test_geometry_cache_lru.py`) is likely skipped by normal test discovery and behaves like orphaned test debt.
A workflow file appears parked/disabled by suffix (`.github/workflows/no-bare-except.yml_dep`).
gaps: No clear pruning boundary for historical code vs active runtime code.
Potentially dead CI quality gate for bare-except policy enforcement.
At least one unit test appears structurally easy to miss in standard tooling.

phase_status.phase: API consolidation (safe wrappers and single-source contracts)
evidence: Safe API wrapper exists (`revit/safe_api.py`) and is used in collection/pipeline call paths.
Pipeline still has broad print-based exception handling in export/debug branches instead of consistently funneling through diagnostics helpers.
safe_api fallback helper references `diag` in local scopes where it is not defined, indicating error-path fragility.
gaps: Error handling style is not fully consolidated under one policy abstraction.
Fallback diagnostics path has potential NameError risk while handling exceptions.

evidence: Core geometry modules are split into focused units (`core/silhouette.py`, `core/areal_extraction.py`, `core/face_selection.py`).
Implementation plan marks geometry and silhouette phases complete.
Dedicated geometry-related tests exist for areal extraction, silhouette/front-face strategies, and raster semantics.
gaps: Proxy edge rasterization mode still has a declared non-implementation path in pipeline (`_stamp_proxy_edges` with pass), which weakens complete mode parity.

evidence: Large pytest suite exists and mostly passes (151 passed, 1 failed in local run).
Diagnostics and no-silent-failure rules are documented in `refactor_rules.md`.
Tooling includes bare-except checker and golden comparison utilities.
gaps: Current branch has at least one failing regression test.
If `_dep` workflow is inactive, CI enforcement does not fully match documented discipline.

obsolete_elements.element: Legacy and archive code trees retained in root
obsolete_elements.why_obsolete_or_risky: They preserve historical context but can confuse active ownership boundaries and static analysis scope.
Filename with embedded space may bypass conventional test selectors and editor/test integrations.
`no-bare-except` enforcement appears parked (`.yml_dep`) and may no longer run automatically.
Inline comment says caching is unavailable while module now supports cache-hit semantics, increasing maintenance confusion.

drift_observations.observation: Caching architecture has expanded beyond initial CSV-plan assumptions.
drift_observations.impact: Behavior now includes root/per-view cache-hit row rehydration and multiple hash/signature paths, which may diverge from single-contract expectations.

drift_observations.observation: Plan documentation claims edge rasterization complete, code contains explicit not-implemented branch.
drift_observations.impact: Mode-level contract ambiguity: feature appears complete in plan status but not behaviorally complete in code path.

drift_observations.observation: Regression baseline intent and current config defaults are inconsistent.
drift_observations.impact: Tests and runtime defaults disagree on `export_strategy_diagnostics`, making contract unclear for downstream users.

recommendations.details: Either restore default False in Config or update tests/docs to intentional True default, then add changelog note and explicit migration guidance.
Implement `_stamp_proxy_edges` fully or hard-disable `proxy_mask_mode='edges'` with explicit diagnostics and docs updates.

recommendations.action: Consolidate error handling under safe API + diagnostics
recommendations.details: Replace print-based exception paths in pipeline/caching export branches with `record_error`/`safe_call`; fix undefined-name risk in `safe_api` fallback helper.

recommendations.action: Re-enable or replace bare-except CI quality gate
recommendations.details: Convert `.github/workflows/no-bare-except.yml_dep` into an active workflow and fail PRs on violations.
Rename `tests/new test_geometry_cache_lru.py` to a conventional pytest filename and remove/relocate any archival tests from active suite paths.

recommendations.action: Establish active vs historical code boundary
recommendations.details: Add explicit ownership markers and CI excludes for `legacy/` and `archive/` to prevent accidental coupling.
